name: Borsuk
armament: ZSSW-30 unmanned turret: 30 mm Mk44S Bushmaster II
2x Spike-LR ATGM in a box launcher on the turret right
protection: Modular appliqué armour; amphibious without preparation. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Boxy flat-sided tracked hull with a flat glacis and a fold-up trim vane on the nose
Six dual road wheels and two return rollers per side, rubber band tracks, side skirts
Compact unmanned ZSSW-30 turret set back on the roof, twin Spike box on its right side
Two water jets at the rear; large rear ramp door
variants: Command, recon, ambulance and engineering variants (framework, planned)
